When the portrait disappears, the palette still has to work.

Normal task surfaces stay flat and calm. This strip checks body copy, code hierarchy, syntax colour, borders, and elevated chrome without relying on the hero to create character.

Design mockup only. The portrait is embedded unedited and restricted to the empty state. Palette values outside “Deep Navy” are exploratory and must be derived/audited before any implementation. No crest, decorative menu-bar SVG, fake primary “New Chat” control, full-window wallpaper, or flat-treatment comparison is included.
